question: Elakkakadi dance of Kerala is performed by which of the following tribes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Irular tribe**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Irular tribe** is one of the prominent tribes in Kerala, primarily residing in the Palakkad and Nilgiri Hills.
 
• The Irular community is known for its rich cultural heritage and traditional practices, including unique dance forms.
 
• **Elakkakadi dance** is a notable cultural expression of the Irular tribe, performed during various festivals and community gatherings.
 
• The dance is characterized by rhythmic movements and traditional music, reflecting the tribe's connection to nature and their spiritual beliefs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Irular Tribe**

 
 
• The Irular tribe is primarily found in the Indian states of Tamil Nadu and Kerala.
 
• They are traditionally known for their skills in agriculture, hunting, and snake-catching.
 
• Irulars speak the Irula language, which is part of the Dravidian language family.
 
• They have a deep understanding of herbal medicine and natural remedies, which are integral to their traditional knowledge system.
 
 
 
• **Kurumba Tribe**
 
 
• The Kurumba tribe is another indigenous community in the Nilgiri Hills of Tamil Nadu and Kerala.
 
• They are known for their expertise in honey collection and basket weaving.
 
• The Kurumbas have a distinct cultural identity, with their own language and customs.
 
 
 
• **Adiyan Tribe**
 
 
• The Adiyan tribe is predominantly found in the Wayanad district of Kerala.
 
• They are traditionally agricultural laborers and have a rich oral tradition of folklore and stories.
 
 
 
• **Mavilan Tribe**
 
 
• The Mavilan tribe is found in the Kannur and Kasaragod districts of Kerala.
 
• They are known for their traditional agricultural practices and have a distinct cultural heritage.
